scope: Face-first intermediate geometry with actual planar cut faces on the bed; no joining features
face_pitch_reason: Visual comparison retains both eyes/brows, nose, mouth, chin and forehead; a deeper -20 degree trial clipped an eye
rear_lateral_split: Midpoint of rear-region lateral bounds in the horizontal ear-line frame
orientation_policy: Actual cut plane normal is print +Z; optimize only in-plane yaw. No free 3D tilt.
readiness: Body fit and planar contact only; local sculpted overhang supports, dovetails, seam registration, material and slicing unverified
